detail: every feedback action's comment, written as one doc-control batch of comment.add on a copy, is read back with comments.list on the paragraph its locator names; docx_out.py no longer touches any Word XML. Gap: doc-control's text.normalized is capped (about 18 paragraphs per response), so mapping addresses pages through about 70 re-parsing calls on a 1,300-paragraph draft (the bulk-read API requested 2026-10-13 removes this)
